name: Micross Components - TX, LLC
old_description: With over 40 years of in-depth expertise, Micross CMS provides an unparalleled array of hi-rel microelectronic product, packaging, test & qualification capabilities servicing the space, defense, aerospace, medical, communications, & other hi-rel markets. From pioneering RHSD in 1984, Micross remains the leader as the one source solution for component services. Turnkey & SMI available, S20.20 Certified.
about:
Micross Components - TX, LLC operates from Round Rock, Texas. The company's heritage includes pioneering Robotic Hot Solder Dip (RHSD) technology in 1984, though a formal founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been released.

The company provides a comprehensive suite of microelectronic component modification and qualification services. Its offerings include BGA reballing, robotic hot solder dip, lead attach, CGA attach, trim and form reconditioning, printed circuit board assembly, rework, and repair. Additional capabilities encompass component harvesting, tape and reel packaging, 3D scanning, bake and package, marking, labeling, and kitting. The firm also performs component qualification through fine and gross leak testing, acoustic microscopy, X-ray inspection, X-ray fluorescence analysis, counterfeit mitigation, bill-of-materials monitoring, supplier managed inventory, and outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) services.

Micross serves high-reliability markets including space, defense, aerospace, medical, and communications sectors. Customers range from original equipment manufacturers to defense contractors requiring hi-rel component preparation and testing.

The company emphasizes a single-source solution for component services, offering turnkey and supplier managed inventory (SMI) programs. It holds S20.20 certification for electrostatic discharge control and maintains RoHS compliance.
